cluster_integrity_guarantee: All members of a telemetry cluster reside strictly within one partition. Zero cross-partition cluster leakage.

PARTITION_A_DEVELOPMENT_CALIBRATION.purpose: Algorithm development, prompt engineering, policy compilation calibration, and validator tuning.
PARTITION_A_DEVELOPMENT_CALIBRATION.leakage_boundary: Eligible for prompt development and error analysis. Never used for final held-out accuracy reporting.

PARTITION_B_INDEPENDENT_HELD_OUT_EVALUAT.purpose: Independent, held-out evaluation of empirical accuracy and selective coverage.
PARTITION_B_INDEPENDENT_HELD_OUT_EVALUAT.leakage_boundary: Strictly held-out. Never accessible during prompt authoring or retrieval indexing.

PARTITION_C_AMBIGUOUS_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDE.purpose: Stress testing of abstention safety, context truncation detection, and ambiguous evidence handling.
PARTITION_C_AMBIGUOUS_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDE.leakage_boundary: Isolated cohort for abstention and token-budget guardrail validation.
